items.title: “T-RADAR: Simulating Trademark Examination as an Interactive Retrieval Interface for Conflict Risk Assessment”
items.meta: Seo, Y.; Noah, L.; Min, H.S.; Choi, S. Accepted to ACM SIGIR 2026 Demonstration Track.
items.summary: T-RADAR is a multi-source retrieval system for similar trademarks based on trademark images and names. It predicts conflict risk and registrability through an AI agent based simulation of the back-and-forth process between trademark examiners and applicants.

items.title: “STELLAR: Scene Text Editor for Low-Resource Language and Real-World Data”
items.meta: Seo, Y.; Min, H.S.; Choi, S. Accepted to 2026 AAAI Workshops.
items.summary: STELLAR is a scene text editing model designed for low-resource languages and real-world images. It introduces a ControlNet-based pipeline and a two-stage training strategy, builds its own training dataset, and proposes a new Text Appearance Similarity (TAS) metric for evaluation.

items.title: “CABIN: Controlling Augmentations for Balancing Invariance and Diversification in One-Shot Image Classification”
items.meta: Jung, K.; Seo, Y.; Jung, Y.; Cho, S.; Min, H.S.; Choi, S.; Kim, J. Neurocomputing.
items.summary: CABIN is a data augmentation framework for systematically controlling diversity and class invariance in a one-shot learning setting. It uses class-specific descriptors extracted by an LLM to generate two role-separated types of synthetic data, followed by multi-stage learning.

items.title: “KIMCHI: Korean Diffusion Model Adapting Culture and History”
items.meta: Seo, Y.; Kwon, Y.; Lee, N.; Jung, K.; Cho, S.; Jang, S.; Choi, S. Accepted to 2025 Winter Conference of Society for CDE.
items.summary: KIMCHI is a diffusion model designed to understand Korean text and naturally generate culturally grounded Korean images. It builds a Korean-style image dataset using Korean prompts generated with LLaVA + LLaMA, and fine-tunes both the Ko-CLIP text encoder and the diffusion model with LoRA.

items.title: “DALDA: Data Augmentation Leveraging Diffusion Model and LLM with Adaptive Guidance Scaling”
items.meta: Jung, K.; Seo, Y.; Cho, S.; Kim, J.; Min, H.S.; Choi, S. Accepted to 2024 ECCV Workshops.
items.summary: DALDA is a data augmentation framework that balances the diversity and consistency of synthetic data in a few-shot learning setting. It proposes Adaptive Guidance Scaling, which dynamically adjusts synthesis weights according to the CLIPScore of real samples.

items.title: PARAVOCA: 관광 데이터를 판매 가능한 여행상품으로 전환하는 기획·마케팅 AX 에이전트
items.meta: 2026 관광데이터 활용 공모전(생성형 AI 활용 관광 프롬프톤 부문) 우수상
items.summary: PARAVOCA is a multi-agent workflow built with Ennoia, Wanted Lab’s no-code platform. Users can enter a region, theme, target audience, and duration to generate verified tourist attraction candidates, product structures, draft proposals, marketing copy, operations checklists, and AI-generated posters.

items.title: SAM Auto-Annotator: Production Auto-Annotation Workflow
items.meta: Tomocube Inc. internship project. Segment Anything Model based annotation assistance for internal production use.
items.summary: SAM Auto-Annotator is a web-based, high-precision and high-efficiency auto-annotation system developed during my internship at Tomocube for building cell image datasets. I built the backend server, implemented Segment Anything Model based annotation and fine-tuning features, and deployed the tool for internal use.
